evidence.name: environment
evidence.evidence: The green overlay covers the sky area at the top of the image.

evidence.name: obstacles
evidence.evidence: The green covers the top of the image, which is not a standable surface. It also covers parts of the trees, which are obstacles.

evidence.name: coverage
evidence.evidence: The standable floor is almost entirely covered by green, with only small portions of the road and the areas around the fishing nets not covered.

environment.instructions: Does GREEN cover water, sky or walls? Only green pixels count; missing floor is never an error.

criteria.true: Green includes water, sky or wall surfaces
criteria.false: No green on water, sky or walls

obstacles.instructions: Does GREEN cover any non-standable furniture, counters, pews, crates, barrels, nets, fences, posts, railings or other obstacles, including unlabelled ones? Ignore missing floor and intentional clearance margins.

coverage.instructions: Estimate the fraction of visible standable floor covered by GREEN, from 0 to 1. Missing floor is a coverage note only and never a rejection.
criteria: All visible standable floor is covered by green
